## Dropped move sets

## Data gaps and assumptions

- a runnable costs the same on every core: its declared wcet is not scaled by the target core
- bytes x Hz is not a transport cost: it is the logical volume a link carries, never a bus or a communication-stack cost
- sizes are logical: bits from the base type's size over 8; alignment, padding and every transport overhead (headers, serialisation, protection) are excluded
- client-server calls are counted, never costed
- memory stays where it is: a memory only bounds where a component may move
- no task is created, moved whole or re-budgeted: each candidate states the wcet edit of every task it touches and applies none
- an advisory core's breach is reported and never constrained
- the constant C0 = 0 bytes x Hz is the cost of the crossing links whose crossing no admissible move changes; every objective this report states includes it once
- moving 'X' into partition 'PB' is admissible: an unrated partition
- moving 'X' into partition 'PC' is admissible: an unrated partition
- moving 'Z' into partition 'PB' is admissible: an unrated partition
- moving 'Z' into partition 'PC' is admissible: an unrated partition
